{
  "phoneNote": "The primary 'Rezervirajte mizo' action in the hero loses its button styling on mobile, becoming a plain underlined link, and the opening hours section repeats the same sentence twice right above the footer which repeats the hours again.",
  "desktopNote": "The menu section is awkwardly constrained to the left half of the screen, leaving a massive empty white void on the right, and the bright neon green photo drop-shadows clash with the traditional rustic aesthetic.",

    "impression": 4,

    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 4,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Style the primary 'Rezervirajte mizo' CTA on mobile as a solid dark-green button just like on desktop so the main action stands out.",
    "Use a two-column layout for the 'Kaj kuhamo' menu section on desktop (putting 'Prleška kuhinja' on the left and 'Degustacijski meni' on the right) to fill the empty right half of the screen.",
    "Change the harsh neon-green offset borders behind the photos to a muted olive or wine tone, and remove the redundant 'Kdaj smo odprti' section right above the footer."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "On phone in the 'Kdaj smo odprti' section, the note 'V ponedeljek in torek samo za zaključene družbe. Rezervacija je obvezna.' is printed twice in a row.",
    "On phone, the 'Kdaj smo odprti' section and the 'Delovni čas' block immediately below it in the footer repeat the exact same opening hours back-to-back."
  ]
}
